title: Ligan a proceso a exestudiantes del colegio Continental Americano por incidente de fotomontaje con imágenes de sus compañeras
summary: Four former students of Colegio Continental Americano were linked to a legal process for creating photomontages of their classmates' faces on nude bodies.
